creed-mens-5-piece-discovery-set.seo_title: Creed Men's Discovery Set: worth it? Yes, at $7.76/ml
creed-mens-5-piece-discovery-set.description: Our verdict: a safe blind buy. Five Creeds, about 49 ml, $380 at Bluemercury ($7.76/ml), so you choose a signature before a full bottle. Checked Nov 19.
creed-mens-5-piece-discovery-set.lead: Safe blind buy? Yes, because five Creeds in one box lets you choose a signature before you commit to a full bottle.

tom-ford-private-blend-luxe-discovery-se.seo_title: Tom Ford Luxe Discovery Set: worth it? Yes, if in stock
tom-ford-private-blend-luxe-discovery-se.description: Our verdict: a safe blind buy. Four Private Blends incl. Oud Wood and Lost Cherry, $100 for 12 ml at Bluemercury; out of stock when checked Nov 19.
tom-ford-private-blend-luxe-discovery-se.lead: Safe blind buy? Yes, if you can get one: four Private Blends for $100 is the low-risk way into the line.

mfk-5-piece-holiday-miniature-set.seo_title: MFK Holiday Mini Set: worth it? Only if you love MFK
mfk-5-piece-holiday-miniature-set.description: Our verdict: yes if you already love MFK; sample first if you are new to the house. Five 10 ml bottles, $325 at Dillard's ($6.50/ml). Checked Nov 19.
mfk-5-piece-holiday-miniature-set.lead: Safe blind buy? Only if you already love MFK; sample first if you are new to the house.
